# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Features

- Initial release of license-guard and license-forge
- Ed25519 signature-based license validation
- Global and direct verification APIs
- CLI tool for license generation and management
- Product-centric license organization
- Shell completions for bash/zsh/fish
